typesense:latest.greeting:
*"Join us... You are one of us..."*
*You wake early in the morning, before the sun has risen, a strange warm feeling all over your body. You vaguely remember dreams of a shadowy forest, of strange beasts circling you, but cannot keep it straight in your mind. You feel ill. Then, sitting up, you see it... your body is no longer human!*

*But, when you glance at the mirror across the room, you see your normal human face... even as you reach up and feel something different where your mouth should be.*

(Describe your new body, ideally in your bio, and mention what setting you're in.)
typesense:latest.name: Unseen Fur
typesense:latest.title: Become a furry in a human world, but only other furries can see your true form!
